originality.rationale: Demonstrated coverage of the full mathematical conclusion via the broader Lucas/minimal-zero-sum criterion in Resultary 339a752cfdc3 and the prior global maximum theorem of Fairfax-Ball. For p<N=p+s with s the least positive residue of -p mod m, W(N) is s copies of 1 and one residue -s. A subset without -s must be empty to sum to zero, and one containing it must use all s ones. Below p any admissible N>=2m has at least m ones as a proper zero-sum subset. Hence the first positive row is T. Moreover T<p^2 and Kummer or the Legendre valuation formula bounds every coefficient by 1 there: the broad criterion therefore implies coefficientwise exactness, not just a gcd-level assertion. The November catalog date establishes neither priority nor dependence; mathematical coverage is the reason for FAIL, not an assertion that the exact formula was published first in that text.
residual_risks: Catalog dates do not settle historical priority; no allegation of dependence. The proof of implication and overlap is independent of such priority.
The distinct non-coprime-lower-index selection literature was not fully compared, but cannot undo the explicit coverage demonstrated here.
